chunks: Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Abī Ja‘far عليه السلام, who said:
Qunoot is in every two rak‘ahs in the optional and obligatory prayers.

key_terms.الْقُنُوتُ: the supplication recited in salat at the prescribed place

ai.seo_question: Is qunoot recited in both optional and obligatory prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith states the ruling that qunoot is prescribed in every two rak‘ahs, both in supererogatory prayers and in obligatory prayers. It highlights the regular place of supplication within salat and its application across different categories of prayer.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1413 - Muhammad ibn Muslim narrated from Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) who said:
"There is Qunoot (a supplication) in every two rak'ahs of the optional (supererogatory) and obligatory prayers."
